transformation_or_definition: Economic Report of the President 2026, Appendix B, Table B-47, annual outlays by function.
Fiscal years 1960-2025 inclusive (66 annual observations).
source_or_note: FY is fiscal year, not calendar year.

transformation_or_definition: All dollar amounts are billions of nominal USD, not inflation-adjusted.
Use total federal outlays, including on-budget and off-budget spending.
National defense -> defense.
International affairs -> international.
Health -> health (does not include separately listed Medicare).
Medicare -> medicare.
Income security -> income_security.
Social security -> social_security.
Net interest -> net_interest.
Other outlays -> other. Includes education and space/science among other functions; NOT a dedicated R&D category.
Each *_pct_total = corresponding * / total * 100.
For each year show eight segment percentages in one 100% stacked bar.
source_or_note: Minor discrepancies from 100% are published source rounding.

transformation_or_definition: categories_sum = sum of eight raw expenditure categories; rounding_difference = total - categories_sum.
source_or_note: Never silently modify original category values to force exact reconciliation.

transformation_or_definition: Not included as a separate annual column, even though the transition quarter may be reported in other federal fiscal history series.
Other is not technology; federal R&D also appears within national defense, health and other sectors.
source_or_note: Do not add R&D to these segments without netting out cross-category overlap.

transformation_or_definition: OMB historical functional expenditure tables (e.g., Table 3.2) support more detailed research/education/space splits.
B–47 displays dots, not numerical zero. The original chart and CSV encoded these as 0 for plotting; the source status column preserves this distinction.
Compared all 66 annual totals and eight categories against Table B–47. Source dots were treated as described in step 19; 1976 transition quarter excluded.
Official published Table B–47 directly inspected. It credits Treasury and OMB; upstream underlying series were not separately audited.
Source values are published to 0.1 billion; derived percentages use those rounded values. Sum and difference are arithmetic from displayed values.
